summary:
Implemented the missing emitter API in src/emitter.ts (only file changed):
- `on` (src/emitter.ts:11) now returns an unsubscribe `() => void` that calls `off` with the same listener reference (idempotent).
- Added `off` (src/emitter.ts:18): removes one listener by reference via indexOf/splice.
- Added `once` (src/emitter.ts:25): registers a type-erased wrapper that removes itself before invoking the listener, and returns a cancel function.
- Added `listenerCount` (src/emitter.ts:33): returns the live listener count for an event (0 if none).
- `emit` (src/emitter.ts:36) now runs every listener in a snapshot of the list inside try/catch, records the first thrown error, and rethrows it after all listeners have run; still returns false when no listeners exist.

Verification: `tsc --noEmit -p . && node --test` from the repo root exits 0 — typecheck clean (including types-test/ with its @ts-expect-error cases) and all 6 tests in test/emitter.test.ts pass. No files under test/, types-test/, or tsconfig.json were touched.
